About Interface.ai

Our mission is to make intelligent, personalized financial services accessible to everyone. interface.ai builds AI agents for the banks and credit unions that serve everyday Americans, helping financial institutions deliver better service and making it easier for people to get the support they need.

More than 100 banks and credit unions use interface.ai, reaching over 10 million people. Our ambition is to help millions of people navigate their financial lives with greater confidence.

The Role

As our Applied AI Engineer, Business Automation, you'll build the systems that make every team at interface.ai more productive. Work across engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer success, finance, operations, and talent to understand how work gets done, identify the highest-impact opportunities, and turn recurring business processes into reliable AI-powered workflows.

Bonus Points

Built internal platforms or tools that employees across multiple functions adopted and relied on.
Delivered AI automation with measurable improvements in employee productivity, operating cost, or turnaround time.

Experience building reusable agent capabilities, durable workflows, or evaluation systems for business processes.
Experience as an early engineer at a startup, taking products from initial discovery through sustained production use.

Compensation

, plus equity and the benefits below. Base salary will reflect the role's level and the candidate's relevant experience, skills, and demonstrated ability to build and own production systems.

Build AI that expands what people can accomplish. In this role, your work will give colleagues more time for customers, better information for decisions, and dependable systems for getting work done. Every successful workflow helps the company move faster toward its mission of making intelligent financial services accessible to everyone.

You'll work directly with Srinivas Njay (CEO) and Bruce Kim (CTO / Co-Founder), with access to the teams using what you build and the tools to turn ideas into working systems. Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About The Role

Anthropic's Life Sciences team is building a research group focused on biological discoveries by combining AI with hands-on biological research. We're seeking a research scientist who combines deep chemistry knowledge with machine learning expertise to join the team. Our goal is to speed up progress in the life sciences by an order of magnitude, and this role puts that mission into practice. You'll be a computational chemist who knows reactions, synthesis, and medicinal chemistry in depth and has hands-on experience training and evaluating machine learning models. Above all, you'll build the reinforcement learning environments, datasets, and evaluations that teach Claude chemistry. The Lilly Employer Organization is a critical priority for Lilly USA. It treats employers as first-class customers alongside payers and providers, and it scales Lilly's direct-to-employer (DTE) access models, benefit design innovation, and employer engagement, particularly for obesity and cardiometabolic medicines. The Lilly USA Tech@Lilly Market Access team is seeking a Principal AI/ML Engineer to build the agentic AI and machine learning platforms that power this work. You will turn prototypes into reliable, scalable, well-governed production systems. You will also build the employer data pipelines, partner integrations, and ML engineering foundations that the team reuses across employer use cases.

What You'll Be Doing

As a Principal AI/ML Engineer, you will design and build the engineering backbone for the AI and ML systems that serve the Lilly Employer Organization: the orchestration frameworks, end-to-end data and model pipelines, serving infrastructure, and the evaluation and monitoring that keep them reliable in production. You will work at the intersection of employer data, benefit administration, field operations, and third-party partner integrations. You will partner closely with data scientists to productionize models and agentic workflows. You will also work with the Employer Technical Product Manager, employer field teams, and Tech@Lilly colleagues to bring those solutions into real applications in a secure and auditable way. You will reuse infrastructure and patterns so that each new employer workflow is faster and cheaper to ship.

Build and operationalize agentic AI platforms, including agent-to-agent orchestration frameworks, multi-agent workflow engines, tool and API integration layers, and secure connectivity between agents, enterprise systems, and external partner platforms.

Build and integrate employer data pipelines, bringing data from employers, benefit administrators, and third-party partners into secure, analytics-ready platforms.

Deliver AI capabilities for employer use cases, such as employer reporting, predictive analytics, benefit optimization, and decision support for employer field teams.

Engineer robust, end-to-end AI/ML pipelines, covering data capture, feature engineering, training, fine-tuning, inference, and feedback, at production scale and reliability.

Stand up ML engineering foundations, including model and prompt versioning, registries, experiment tracking, continuous integration and delivery for models, and automated evaluation and rollback within each pipeline.

Apply production-grade deployment techniques, including scalable model serving, containerization, inference optimization, and deployment of small and specialized models hosted in-house, with attention to latency, cost, scalability, and data residency.

Build observability and monitoring for AI systems, including tracing of agentic workflows, cost and latency tracking, drift detection, and integration of AI evaluation into production monitoring.

Implement governance and data-protection controls, including HIPAA compliance, PHI and PII handling, de-identification, and auditability consistent with a regulated environment.

Design reusable, horizontal engineering capabilities and shared infrastructure that multiple teams and use cases can build on, rather than one-off deployments.

Partner with data scientists to productionize prototypes and harden them for scale, reliability, and maintainability.

Communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders and stay current with emerging agentic and ML engineering tooling.

Manage and prioritize multiple projects simultaneously.

What You Should Bring

Foundational knowledge in communication, leadership, teamwork, problem solving, solution and blueprint definition, business acumen, architectural processes (e.g., blueprinting, reference architecture, governance), technical standards, project delivery, and the industry.

Business Analysis And Technical Leadership, Including

Engaging with the business and proactively seeking opportunities to deliver business value.

Understanding business requirements and effectively translating business needs and processes into technical terms, and vice versa.

Eliciting and defining requirements.

Ensuring appropriate business roles are engaged in solution execution.

Participating in design reviews to ensure traceability of requirements.

Networking with appropriate Tech@Lilly colleagues to determine solutions that meet business partners' needs.

Seeking opportunities to reuse existing processes and services to streamline support and implementation of key systems.

Staying abreast of tools and technologies to influence Tech@Lilly strategy so that it provides the best usage opportunities for the business.

Basic Qualifications

Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or another quantitative or technical field, and 2 + years of experience developing, deploying, or maintaining AI, machine learning, or data systems in production environments.

OR Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or another quantitative or technical field, and 4 + years of experience developing, deploying, or maintaining AI, machine learning, or data systems in production environments.

Qualified applicants must be authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. Lilly will not provide support for or sponsor work authorization or visas for this role, including but not limited to F-1 CPT, F-1 OPT, F-1 STEM OPT, J-1, H-1B, TN, O-1, E-3, H-1B1, or L-1.

Preferred Qualifications

Strong proficiency in Python and sound software-engineering practices, including version control, testing, and code review.

Experience building and deploying data or ML systems in production.

Agentic platforms: experience engineering agent-to-agent orchestration and multi-agent workflow frameworks with modern tooling (e.g., LangGraph, LangChain, or equivalent), including tool and API integration and secure agent connectivity.

End-to-end ML engineering: experience with model and prompt versioning, registries, experiment tracking, continuous integration and delivery for models, automated evaluation in pipelines, and observability for AI systems.

Production deployment: experience with scalable model serving, containerization, inference optimization, and deployment and serving of large models and small, specialized models, plus fine-tuning and distillation pipelines.

Data engineering: experience building scalable data pipelines, SQL and NoSQL data stores, distributed processing, vector databases, and retrieval systems.

Cloud and tooling: experience with AWS or Azure, Databricks, containers, Git, and CI/CD automation.

Governance: experience with secure, auditable systems, PHI and PII handling, and data-residency constraints.

Partner integrations: experience integrating data and services from external partners, such as benefit administrators or health platforms, through APIs and secure data exchange.

Domain: understanding of U.S. employer healthcare, including employer-sponsored benefits, benefit design, payers, PBMs, and access models. Experience in healthcare or pharma is a plus.

Demonstrated ability to deliver reliable systems in complex data domains and to communicate with a geographically dispersed group of business and technical colleagues.

About The Organization

Lilly IT builds and maintains capabilities with cutting-edge technologies, as the most prominent tech companies do. Lilly IT is different because we use technology to advance our purpose: creating medicines that make life better for people around the world. Examples include data-driven drug discovery, connected clinical trials, and AI that helps patients access and afford their medicines. We hire the best technology professionals from a variety of backgrounds so they can bring an assortment of knowledge, skills, and diverse thinking to deliver innovative solutions in every area of our business.

The Lilly USA Tech@Lilly team is at the forefront of leveraging data and technology to launch new medicines to market, raise awareness, and help appropriate patients get access to medication. With a deep technical and business understanding, working across all therapeutic areas and disease states, we design and implement digital solutions to power our business. What You'll Be Doing

As a Principal AI/ML Engineer, you will design and build the engineering backbone for the AI and ML systems that serve the Lilly Employer Organization: the orchestration frameworks, end-to-end data and model pipelines, serving infrastructure, and the evaluation and monitoring that keep them reliable in production. You will work at the intersection of employer data, benefit administration, field operations, and third-party partner integrations. You will partner closely with data scientists to productionize models and agentic workflows. Build and operationalize agentic AI platforms, including agent-to-agent orchestration frameworks, multi-agent workflow engines, tool and API integration layers, and secure connectivity between agents, enterprise systems, and external partner platforms.

Build and integrate employer data pipelines, bringing data from employers, benefit administrators, and third-party partners into secure, analytics-ready platforms.

Deliver AI capabilities for employer use cases, such as employer reporting, predictive analytics, benefit optimization, and decision support for employer field teams.

Engineer robust, end-to-end AI/ML pipelines, covering data capture, feature engineering, training, fine-tuning, inference, and feedback, at production scale and reliability.

Design reusable, horizontal engineering capabilities and shared infrastructure that multiple teams and use cases can build on, rather than one-off deployments.

Partner with data scientists to productionize prototypes and harden them for scale, reliability, and maintainability.

Communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders and stay current with emerging agentic and ML engineering tooling.

Manage and prioritize multiple projects simultaneously.

Foundational knowledge in communication, leadership, teamwork, problem solving, solution and blueprint definition, business acumen, architectural processes (e.g., blueprinting, reference architecture, governance), technical standards, project delivery, and the industry.

Eliciting and defining requirements.

Strong proficiency in Python and sound software-engineering practices, including version control, testing, and code review.

Experience building and deploying data or ML systems in production.

Agentic platforms: experience engineering agent-to-agent orchestration and multi-agent workflow frameworks with modern tooling (e.g., LangGraph, LangChain, or equivalent), including tool and API integration and secure agent connectivity.

Lilly IT builds and maintains capabilities with cutting-edge technologies, as the most prominent tech companies do.
